paragraphs.excerpt: Privacy-preserving generation. Real interaction trajectories require appropriate data-use and de-identification procedures. Agent Hospital illustrates simulated encounters. Simulation supplies an alternative to direct patient-record access, while validity still depends on correspondence with the intended clinical task.

Agent Hospital retains cases and experience text while its base LLMs stay frozen. After 20,000 simulated patients per department, mean internal diagnosis accuracy across 21 departments rises from 77.0% to 95.3%. GPT-4o MedQA accuracy increases from 88.22% to 92.22%, only 0.70 points above the strongest reported…
